notes.title: 🌲Forest Ranger Simulator Fully Released + Major Update!
notes.notes:
Hello Forest Rangers,
The day has finally come! 🏆 

[previewyoutube=F0w2qoI7rYM;full][/previewyoutube]

Today is the BIG DAY we've been waiting for! - full release of Forest Ranger Simulator

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36177732/de6e273e873606187023193d0024ab07d6e2add9.jpg


Thanks for your support, reviews, and information you provided, We've made it to this very moment! ːsteamhappyː 


To celebrate the premiere, we have uploaded a major update!

List of Full Release Update changes:


 Seasons added! Preparatory Season, Tourist Season
 Additional map of forest areas!
 Any forest area can be purchased!
 Expanding forest areas!
 Tourists visiting the forest during the season!
 Water demand system!
 Replenishing the water you need!
 Steam Achievements!
 Minor bug fixes!



If you still haven't you can get Forest Ranger Simulator with a 40% discount, but in a bundle for even less. 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1185780/Forest_Ranger_Simulator/


Relax and have fun
Forest Ranger Simulator team

P.S. Yesterday we announced a big and important game "Purrrifiers". If you want to support us (Freemind or dev of the game) or have a chance to get into the beta test please wishlist now

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2117430/Purrrifiers/

notes.title: 🌲Forest Ranger Simulator🌲 Full Release is coming🐻
notes.notes:

We have a big announcement today❗️

📣Forest Ranger Simulator is getting out of Early Access on June 19! We have prepared a discount💲 and a major update🌲 on the release! Achievements are coming!

From the first day of the Early Access of the game, we've provided a variety of updates. We have always listened to you - our community and give you as much fun as possible in Forest Ranger Simulator.

With the full release, there will be a MAJOR UPDATE uploaded. In the upcoming days, we will share more info about it.



if you still haven't played Forest Ranger Simulator, now could be the right time.
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1185780/Forest_Ranger_Simulator/

Forest Ranger Simulator team
